description: Huatian Dynamic OA8000 collaborative office system contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in /OAapp/jsp/trace/ntkodownload.jsp, where the filename request parameter is used to locate a file without restricting access to an intended directory or rejecting traversal sequences. Attackers can supply ../ sequences to read arbitrary files from the server, such as the Tomcat configuration at ROOT/WEB-INF/web.xml, exposing sensitive configuration, source, and credential material that can enable further compromise. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-11-20.

_relevance.reason: Enterprise OA system path traversal exposing credentials, not core identity/access infrastructure or DPI sector software.

description: The Drag and Drop File Upload for Elementor Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the remove_files function in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.2 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is reachable when the "yeepdf_not_save" privacy option is enabled, a commonly used production setting that triggers the remove_files() cleanup path.

_relevance.reason: WordPress/Elementor plugin explicitly excluded as consumer/hobbyist software per overlay hard excludes.

description: The Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket (/tmp/dynamic_socket) without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

_relevance.reason: Check Point Gaia OS local privilege escalation via unauthenticated socket, not identity/access infrastructure or DPI sector software.

description: A vulnerability was determined in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. This issue affects the function SetRemoteSetting/SetUnsecuredWiFiWarning of the file ui_server.lua of the component JNAP API. This manipulation of the argument isEnabled/enabled causes missing authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

_relevance.reason: Consumer home router missing authentication explicitly excluded per overlay hard excludes.

description: XWEB EVO versions 5.2.3 through before 5.7.0 contains a pre-authentication OS command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands by injecting shell metacharacters into the username field of login.lua, cleanout.lua, or api.lua before the password check occurs. Attackers can exploit this flaw combined with the setuid-root wlua interpreter to execute commands with root privileges, achieving full system compromise. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

_relevance.reason: Industrial HMI/automation software pre-auth command injection, not identity/access infrastructure or DPI sector software.

description: VITEC EZ TV Platform Server before 8.5.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the upload handler that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to upload arbitrary files by supplying a target filename in the X-FILENAME request header with no authentication or file type validation required. Attackers can upload a malicious ASPX file directly to the web-accessible uploads directory, where it is immediately executable by the web server, achieving remote code execution in the context of the web server process. Patches are available for versions 8.3.0, 8.3.1, 8.4.0, and 8.4.1. Users running releases prior to 8.3.0 should upgrade to 8.5.0+.

_relevance.reason: Broadcast/media server unrestricted file upload, not identity/access infrastructure or DPI sector software.

description: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in generateCookie() in system/user/user.php that uses loose comparison to validate MD5 cookie hashes. Unauthenticated attackers can brute-force cookie values until the server's MD5 computation yields a 0e magic hash, then forge persistent cookies for account takeover.

_relevance.reason: Authentication bypass in hobbyist web editor falls under consumer software exclusion.

description:
The MISP Modules website component contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the external tools management interface. The /external_tools/list endpoint returned stored API keys (the api_key field) in its JSON response via the ExternalTools model serializer. Additionally, the browser-based edit form pre-populated the API key input field with the stored credential value, exposing it in the DOM.

The /external_tools/list endpoint is accessible without authentication (the regression tests verify the response for both authenticated and unauthenticated clients), meaning any network-reachable client could retrieve the API keys for all configured external tools. These keys are used by the server to authenticate submissions to external analysis or enrichment services, so their disclosure allows an attacker to impersonate the MISP instance or directly access those external services.

The vulnerability also affected the edit workflow: the change_config endpoint previously required the API key to be present and non-empty on every save, forcing the key to round-trip through the client. The browser JavaScript stored the key in a reactive state object and updated the in-memory tool list with the credential value, further increasing the window of exposure in client-side memory and network traffic.

Affected component: the website sub-application of MISP Modules, specifically the external_tools module (serializer in models.py, list endpoint, and the external_tools_index.html template). The impact is limited to confidentiality of the stored API keys; no integrity or availability impact on the MISP Modules website itself is indicated by the patch.

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated API key disclosure in threat intelligence platform lacks identity or access-control nexus.

description: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate the password-recovery reset URL by injecting the HTTP Host header into the /v1/lostpass/ route's token generation process. Attackers can lure an automated mail-security scanner into visiting the poisoned reset link to exfiltrate the live recovery token, replay it at /login/index.php?acc=newpass to set a new password, and subsequently abuse the File Manager and Crontab modules to achieve command execution as the targeted hosting account.

_relevance.reason: Password recovery bypass in commercial hosting control panel lacks public-sector identity or DPI infrastructure nexus.

description: XWEB EVO 4.3.0 through 5.8.8 contains an unauthenticated arbitrary file write vulnerability that allows remote attackers to modify the system configuration file /etc/xwebconfig.json by sending a crafted POST request to config.lua with action=set, which performs no session validation and writes the raw, unvalidated request body. Attackers can tamper with configuration values such as model and plugin fields or trigger a SYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED state via the unauthenticated action=get and action=set operations, resulting in configuration tampering and denial of service. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated config tampering in a generic web server product (XWEB EVO) with no identity, government, or DPI-sector nexus; also EOL.

description: Grav Login plugin before 3.11.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with an account password to skip two-factor verification when the global twofa_enabled setting is off. Attackers can sign in through the /login form, remember-me cookie, or magic link to obtain a session the API plugin accepts, gaining full account permissions including super-admin control.

_relevance.reason: Authentication bypass in a CMS plugin (Grav Login), explicitly excluded as consumer/hobbyist web software per overlay rules.
